title: Tail of Trouble
story: The gateway stopped during a deploy. Its log is long, the incident channel is impatient, and the useful part is usually where the story ends.
objective: Print exactly the final three lines of /var/log/gateway.log.
hints: tail reads from the end of a file.
The -n option controls how many lines are printed.
explanation: tail is ideal for inspecting the newest part of an append-only log. Use -n to keep the output focused when a file is large.
